entities.summary: Labiba Hashim (1952-1882) was a Lebanese author who founded and published Fatat al-Sharq magazine in Cairo in 1906, one of the first female-oriented magazines of the Arab world. In the magazine Hashim advocated for women's rights, especially rights related to women's education and involvement in politics. Today, many researchers are working to collect information about Hashim in order to preserve her heritage and legacy.
